info.title: UTME Lab API
info.description: A keyed question bank for Nigerian entry exams. Every question is keyed to a subtopic so a weak spot is a twenty-question sitting rather than a mock. Explanations carry the trap that catches people. Send your key in the `X-API-Key` header; the whole surface is keyed.

get.summary: One syllabus topic, with its examinable objectives.

Blueprint.description:
Measured expectations for one exam subject. Every measurement is
optional — a row states only what was measured, never a filled-in
zero. Empty result where no rows exist is honest absence, not 404.

Coverage.description: Coverage without the tree: the same counts and nothing else.

Exam.description:
One exam as stored. Facts live here, not scattered across call sites.

`status` is a passthrough string (`live` | `planned` | `retired`
today): a new board status must keep serving, never break
deserialization of every row. Nullable columns stay `Option` for the
same honesty — unstated is null, never invented.

countries.description: Member countries running this exam. Empty where unstated.

duration_minutes.description: Minutes for a full sitting, verified only. Null where unverified.

has_full_paper.description:
Whether a full paper can be assembled at all. Null where it
cannot be stated.

rules.description: Board-stated rules a consumer must know. Empty where unstated.

subjects_required.description: Subjects in a full paper (JAMB: 4). Null where unstated.

Explanation.description:
Why the answer is what it is: teaser, working, and the distractor
that catches people.

ImagePosition.description: Where the figure renders relative to the stem. Data, never inferred.

len.description:
Length in Unicode scalar values. Zero for an image anchor, which
marks an attachment point rather than a span.

start.description: Offset in Unicode scalar values from the start of `text`.

Inline.description:
One offset mark. Serialised flat with an adjacent `kind` tag, e.g.
`{"start":24,"len":6,"kind":"underline"}`.

KeyInfo.description:
The caller's own key, as the key itself may see it. No hashes,
no secrets, no other keys — safe to hand to whoever presented it.

Novel.description:
A prescribed text. One row per (exam, cycle) — the set text rotates,
so the prescription years are load-bearing, not decorative.

category.description: Which paper sets it: reading text or prescribed literature.

featured.description: At most one per exam — the current set text.

year_prescribed.description: Every cycle this is (or was) the set text for.

year_published.description: Unknown for older set texts — absent, not zero.

summary.description: Null means not yet written — absence is the signal.

NovelDoc.description:
One novel with everything: book, chapters, characters, themes, quiz.
Matches the established detail shape exactly, answers included —
callers already read quiz rows here, so withholding would silently
change the contract rather than improve it.

NovelQuestion.description:
A quiz item about the book. Points at a chapter, not a subtopic;
the novel is the passage, so there is no passage id.

answer.description: An option id, same contract as `Question.answer`.

Page_RenderedNovelQuestion.description:
One page of a collection in the shape every paged endpoint serves.
The envelope lives here, once, so a new paged endpoint cannot
re-derive the counts: `total_pages` comes from `total_records` and
`per_page` through [`Page::new`], never from the call site.

The collection field is `questions` because both surfaces that page
today page questions; a future non-question page renames it there.

items.description:
One novel quiz row as served. `novel_id` is stamped by the caller —
the stored row does not carry it.

Page_RenderedQuestion.description:
One page of a collection in the shape every paged endpoint serves.
The envelope lives here, once, so a new paged endpoint cannot
re-derive the counts: `total_pages` comes from `total_records` and
`per_page` through [`Page::new`], never from the call site.

The collection field is `questions` because both surfaces that page
today page questions; a future non-question page renames it there.

items.description:
One question as served. Identical to storage except the answer and
working, which are present only when explicitly requested — an answer
in a default payload gets rendered by somebody, eventually, by
accident. `verified` comes from the verification log, never a stored flag.

answer.description: Present only when explanations were requested.

passage_id.description:
A stimulus this row belongs to — fetch it, never ignore it: the
stem may be unanswerable without it.

PaperMode.description:
Which gate built a paper (D70). Disclosed on the wire: a consumer must
be able to tell a balanced mock from a full-length draw.

PaperReadiness.description:
The scheme plus whether the bank can fill it. Readiness sits beside the
scheme rather than inside it, so the validated shape does not move as
our content grows.

complete.description:
True when every requirement group for this scope holds enough
verified questions to fill its `min_select` slots.

Passage.description:
A stimulus shared by many questions — one comprehension passage
serving five questions, one cloze serving ten. Questions carry only
the id; consumers resolve it here, never ignore it.

PublicExam.description:
One exam as the discovery surface serves it: identity, size, and its
subjects. No board rules, no paper shape, nothing a key is for.

countries.description: Member countries running this exam. Empty where unstated.

duration_minutes.description: Minutes for a full sitting. Null where the board's shape is unstated.

PublicSubject.description:
One subject on the discovery surface: the name, whether the board makes
it compulsory, and how many rows sit behind it.

objective_paper_questions.description:
MCQs the objective paper holds. Null where unverified, never zero
standing in for a fact nobody stated.

PublicSummary.description:
Totals for the discovery surface, served without a key.

`held` is every row on file; `verified` is the subset whose latest human
verification passed under the rule every keyed read applies (see
`store::catalog`). Both are here because both are real reads on the keyed
surface: a default page returns `held` rows, and `?verified=true` returns
`verified`, so a published figure can always be reconciled with a call.
It is the same pair `SubjectStat` already serves.

RenderedNovelQuestion.description:
One novel quiz row as served. `novel_id` is stamped by the caller —
the stored row does not carry it.

RenderedQuestion.description:
One question as served. Identical to storage except the answer and
working, which are present only when explicitly requested — an answer
in a default payload gets rendered by somebody, eventually, by
accident. `verified` comes from the verification log, never a stored flag.

answer.description: Present only when explanations were requested.

passage_id.description:
A stimulus this row belongs to — fetch it, never ignore it: the
stem may be unanswerable without it.

detail.description:
Optional context, capped at [`crate::core::reports::MAX_DETAIL_CHARS`]
characters. No PII.

reason.description:
One of: wrong_answer, unclear_stem, broken_option,
wrong_explanation, other.

target_id.description:
The target's id. Topics have no single id, so theirs is the
slash-joined `exam/subject/slug`.

target_type.description: One of: question, topic, passage, novel.

ReportFiled.description:
Outcome of filing a consumer flag. `duplicate` is true when an
identical filing already existed; `id` is then the original's.

Requirement.description:
One board rule about which subjects a paper needs. An empty `subjects`
means "every exam subject not named by another group"; `min_select` is
how many of that pool must be ready before the paper is real.

RichText.description:
Plain text plus offset marks. `text` stays searchable as characters;
structure rides in `inline` as Unicode-scalar offsets, never bytes.

SampledQuestions.description: A sampled set of questions for fast practice or quick quiz flows.

Scheme.description:
How an exam's paper is shaped, restated from the bank (D19). This is a
constant over our content, so it moves only when the bank does.

country.description:
Country scope this scheme was computed for. Absent means the full
honest view, and completeness is only ever claimed for a scope.

duration_minutes.description: Minutes for a full sitting, verified only. Null where unverified.

questions_available.description:
Questions a full paper holds, summed from subjects we can fill.
A lower bound for any exam whose bank is incomplete.

requirements.description:
The paper-assembly rules evaluated for this scope, copied from the
exam's requirement rows so a consumer sees what `complete` meant.

rules.description: Board-stated rules a consumer must know. Empty where unstated.

subjects_ready.description: Which subjects can fill a slot today, by slug.

Subject.description:
One exam's offering of a subject. The same concept appears once per
exam carrying that board's own name — not one row with an alias.

objective_paper_questions.description:
MCQs the objective paper holds. Null where unverified — absence
is data, never a zero masquerading as a fact.

SubjectSlot.description:
One subject's slot in an exam scheme. `questions` is the stated paper
size (null where unverified), and `marks_per_question` is stated only
where the bank supports it — both are absences, never zeros.

Syllabus.description: One subject's whole topic tree with live counts.

countries.description: Inherited from the parent topic — a subtopic carries no scope of its own.

SyllabusSummary.description: Counts over a subject's syllabus, for progress bars and checklists.

SyllabusTopic.description:
One node of a subject's syllabus as served: what you must be able to do
(objectives) beside what you can actually practise (`question_count`).
The stored form is `core::papers::SyllabusTopic`; this one adds counts.

countries.description: Countries this topic belongs to. Empty means every member country.

Topic.description: A topic within one exam's syllabus.

objectives.description:
Examinable statements attached at topic level. Empty where the
board states none — never invented.

weight.description:
Marks the board gives this topic. Zero means "not published",
never "worth nothing" — a fabricated weight would reach
consumers as a fact.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Send your key in the `X-API-Key` header. One key type: it works from a server, an app, or curl — we never ask where it lives. If you embed it in a client app it can be extracted, and whoever extracts it shares your quota.

tags.name: public
tags.description: What is in the bank, before you have a key. No credential, coarse on purpose.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Exams, subjects, syllabi, topics, blueprints, passages and prescribed texts.
